cases.name: bbm_variant_families
cases.reason: Exercises the package's regular double-struck, sans-serif double-struck, and monospace variants so the reference scene exposes their selected glyph outlines.

cases.name: bbm_mathversion_switch
cases.reason: Exercises regular and bold outlines, then explicitly restores the package option to normal in the same formula. ChangeBold mutates parser.options.bbm.bold, so the reset makes the state transition visible without depending on fixture order.

untested_branches: mathbbmtt bold selection (it intentionally uses fixed monospace)
mathversion values other than bold (they set bold=false)
same-formula restoration after a bold switch; the proposed switch case is amended to restore normal

cases.name: bboldx_normal_and_bold_greek

source_evidence.method: bboldx-mathchar0miNormal bbGamma; bboldx-mathchar0miBold bfbbGamma; CommandMap mathbb/mathbfbb

cases.reason: Exercises normal and bold double-struck commands plus explicit Greek glyph mappings in both variants.

untested_branches: light option and its interaction with bold
text-bboldx parser integration and text font selection
dotless i/j and remaining normal/bold character-map entries

cases.name: dsfont_symbols
cases.reason: Exercises dsfont's default upright double-struck font on a letter and a digit.

untested_branches: dsfont.sans=true alternate -ds-ss selection
other glyph coverage and surrounding font context

cases.name: unknown_macro_fallback
cases.reason: The enabled package's fallback converts an unrecognized macro into styled mtext, rather than leaving it as a parser error.

untested_branches: nondefault background and size options
the remaining fallback-context and malformed control-sequence cases

cases.name: tagformat_display_tag
cases.reason: Exercises the display equation tag path and the active default formatter that wraps a tag in parentheses.

untested_branches: number/ref/id/url callbacks
automatic numbering, references, duplicate labels, and custom callback identities

cases.name: texhtml_default_policy
cases.reason: Production-default policy witness only: allowTexHTML defaults false and TexHTML immediately returns false at the guard. Under this exact profile the reference renders the markup literally across 10 SVG fragments and creates no HTML nodes. A reference fixture must preserve the rendered result and fragment split; this does not claim enabled HTML parsing coverage, and the option must not be enabled for this case.

untested_branches: allowTexHTML=true parsing, adaptor-backed HTML nodes, nested tex-html markers, and malformed closing tags; these are outside the production-default policy witness

cases.name: textcomp_unicode_glyphs

source_evidence.method: TextcompConfiguration CONFIG adds text-textcomp to textmacros

cases.reason: Exercises text-mode macro dispatch and two mapped Unicode text glyphs.

untested_branches: the remaining textcomp command map, including combining and supplementary-plane mappings
text macro behavior outside the selected euro/copyright pair

cases.name: textmacros_style_and_embedded_math

source_evidence.method: TextMacrosConfiguration text parser setup and default package list

cases.reason: Combines text-style macro expansion with the text parser's embedded inline-math path.

untested_branches: the remaining text style macros and nested macro combinations
unclosed text groups and embedded-math delimiter/error branches

cases.name: unicode_hex_and_decimal_char
cases.reason: Exercises hexadecimal codepoint input and TeX char's quoted hexadecimal form, producing explicit Greek Unicode characters.

cases.name: unicode_bad_argument
cases.reason: A bounded malformed-input witness for the package's explicit nonnumeric argument error.

untested_branches: RawUnicode (\U), octal/decimal/backtick Char forms, HD overrides, font-family options, cache reuse
BadFont and BadRawUnicode validations and codepoint boundary cases

cases.name: units_value_and_fraction
cases.reason: Exercises a unit with optional numeric value and the unit fraction expansion into a nice fraction.

untested_branches: direct nicefrac use, loose/ugly options, and optional font selection
missing/empty fraction arguments and spacing branches

cases.name: upright_greek_variants
cases.reason: Exercises lowercase and uppercase upright Greek plus a variant Greek glyph through the package's normal mathvariant mapping.

untested_branches: the remaining uppercase/lowercase/variant Greek map entries
nondefault font context and unknown-command behavior

cases.name: verb_raw_content

source_evidence.method: VerbMethods.Verb delimiter scan, NBSP replacement, monospace mtext

cases.reason: Exercises raw verbatim delimiter scanning with whitespace and TeX-special characters inside the payload.

cases.name: verb_missing_closer
cases.reason: A bounded malformed-input witness for the explicit unmatched-delimiter error.

untested_branches: missing delimiter, alternate delimiters, empty payload, and NBSP serialization details
other delimiter/error edge conditions
